case.summary: Alert HHG-001 is a pure model-score trigger: $77.07 card-present, product W, in billing region 444 on card C12382-K1. Nothing structural supports fraud - the amount is 0.66x the card's mean, channel and product match 99.4% of 358 historical transactions, region 444 already carries 10 prior transactions for this card, and the flagged purchase sits inside a normal two-day run of nine in-person purchases across the cardholder's usual regions with scores of 0.04-0.30. No device or online exposure exists (no device on the txn, no rare shared device, zero online txns in the episode). The card's four prior confirmed-fraud cases and the odd newcomer-fraud cluster in region 444 (0.75 vs 0.10 base rate) justified a quick check, but this card is an established user of 444, not a newcomer. Initial action under R1 was VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER plus CREATE_CASE; on the assumed confirmation the recommendation becomes CLOSE_NO_FRAUD under R3, with the region 444 newcomer cohort (C11201-K1, C00768-K2, C11965-K1, C12634-K1, C05289-K2, C09092-K1) left to the separate regional monitoring already implied by R6 - no report is warranted for this card at $77 exposure.
